q19.

MemoService is served over **gRPC-Gateway (HTTP/JSON REST)** and **Connect**.

- **gRPC-Gateway (REST/JSON over the grpc-gateway mux)** — registered in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:108` via `v1pb.RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer(ctx, gwMux, s)` (the generated handler lives in `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.gw.go`).
- **Connect** — wired in `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go:40` via `wrap(apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler(s, opts...))` inside `RegisterConnectHandlers` (the generated handler constructor lives in `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go`).

Both handlers are backed by the same `APIV1Service` implementation (`s`) — one business-logic source, two protocol front-ends, exactly as the `ConnectServiceHandler` doc comment states at `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go:13-20`.

Note: there is also generated native-gRPC scaffolding (`RegisterMemoServiceServer` in `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service_grpc.pb.go:439`), but I found no call site registering it in `server/`, so the two protocols actually served are gRPC-Gateway and Connect.
